summary: ProAssurance Corporation filed an 8-K updating the status of its acquisition by The Doctors Company via a merger. The merger agreement was signed on March 19, 2025. Stockholder approval was obtained on June 24, 2025, and the FTC granted early HSR termination on July 2, 2025. All required insurance regulatory approvals have now been received. The closing is expected to occur on June 26, 2026, subject to satisfaction of remaining customary conditions. ProAssurance will survive as a wholly owned subsidiary of The Doctors Company. What to watch: the imminent closing and any last-minute regulatory or shareholder conditions.
